messages:
From: Rafael Montoya <rafael.m@edgeapps.io>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@edgeapps.io
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + Dedicated capacity top‑up & autoscale tweaks

Ben —

Quick note as we approach our renewal window (May 1): usage has been trending above our forecast and we want to secure additional dedicated capacity and tighten autoscale behavior to avoid throttled traffic during marketing spikes. Rough asks below: 

- Add 8x A100 reserved GPUs for the 12‑month renewal term (in the same dedicated pool).
- Configure a warm pool so we have 3 live warm replicas ready (warm pool min = 3).
- Raise burst capacity for sustained 15m windows to allow short surges (we can discuss threshold).
- Target scale‑up lag: <= 45s to first token for standard gen routes.
- Throughput target: baseline 320 reqs/min across the dedicated pool (this is our current 95th percentile need).

We also want SLAs around p95/p99 latency and a clarified credit schedule if you miss the target. Can you send a proposed amendment and revised quote? If helpful, Laura from procurement is on copy.

Thanks —
Rafael
Head of Platform — EdgeApps
Rafael Montoya <rafael.m@edgeapps.io>

Attachments: usage-summary-q1.csv (referenced)

Subject: Re: Renewal + Dedicated capacity top‑up & autoscale tweaks

Hi Rafael —

Appreciate the clear ask and heads up on timing. We can absolutely put together an amendment that covers: reserved + burst pool sizing, warm pool min replicas (3), explicit min/max replicas for the service, throughput commitments, and an SLO/credit schedule tied to p95/p99 for the gen routes. A few quick clarifying items that will affect the quote: 

1) GPU SKU: are you locking A100 40GB or A100 80GB (or a mix)? Pricing differs materially.
2) Do you want the warm pool warm replicas to be preloaded with model weights only, or also with a warmed KV cache for your top prompts? Cache warming adds ~10–15% to the warm‑time cost but reduces first‑token latency.
3) Can you confirm the current 95th percentile token length / avg seq length for those routes? That impacts throughput-to-GPU mapping.

I'll work with Renewals (Laura) and CS (Marissa) to get a draft amendment and a one‑page SLA summary. Can we aim to get a signed amendment before May 1? I’ll send a formal proposal by EOD Friday (Apr 3).

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Marissa / Laura —

Following Rafael's note, I put together the operational asks. Please review and confirm pricing/SLA options so I can finalize the amendment for signature: 

EdgeApps asks (summary):
- 12‑month renewal term, start May 1.
- Reserved add: +8 A100 GPUs in same dedicated pool.
- Warm pool: min replicas = 3 (preloaded weights; KV cache optional).
- Min/Max replicas for route: min = 3, max = 24.
- Target scale‑up lag <= 45s to first token; target sustained throughput baseline 320 reqs/min.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 300ms; p99 < 900ms (per‑request, excluding extremely long sequences). Credits: tiered credits (5% for p99 breaches once/month; 15% for repeated monthly breach).

Pricing considerations:
- Option A (A100‑40GB): reservation uplift + warm pool overhead = $X/month (need finance calc).
- Option B (A100‑80GB): ~+20% unit price, fewer GPUs needed for throughput.
- Warm cache prewarm adds ~12% incremental cost but improves first‑token by ~40–60ms.

Attachments: I attached a draft MAP with the preliminary numbers (edgeapps_proposal_20270403.pdf) and the autoscale snippet we'll propose (proposed-autoscale-config.yml). Please confirm the final price (line items) and the SLA credit language we can offer. If we want to be aggressive on the p99 SLO we should keep a larger warm pool or bump burst capacity.

If you want, I can set a 30‑minute sync with Rafael and Laura tomorrow to walk through the tradeoffs before I send the formal amendment.

Thanks —
Ben

Subject: Proposal: EdgeApps renewal amendment & autoscale config

Rafael —

Thanks for the patience. Attached is our formal amendment and a 1‑page SLA summary. Key points below (high level):

- Term: 12 months, May 1 2027 — Apr 30 2028.
- Reserved capacity: +8 A100‑40GB GPUs in existing dedicated pool.
- Warm pool: min replicas = 3 (preloaded weights). KV cache warming available as an add‑on.
- Autoscale min/max replicas: min = 3, max = 24. Warm pool counts toward min.
- Burst policy: sustained bursts up to 20% above baseline for up to 15 minutes per hour; automatic fallback to public models after 5m of sustained saturation (optional).
- Performance SLOs: p95 < 300ms, p99 < 900ms. Scale‑up lag target = 45s.
- Remedies: tiered credits (5% monthly credit for a single p99 breach; 15% for repeated monthly breach).
- Pricing: monthly uplift for reserved GPUs + warm pool overhead = $32,400/month (A100‑40GB option). A100‑80GB option provided in appendix with estimated monthly uplift $38,900/month and recommended pool size of +6 GPUs.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached amendment and sign via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/XYZ-docs/EDGE-2319
2) If you want KV cache prewarm, reply and we'll update the amendment with the add‑on (adds ~12% to monthly).
3) Once signed, we’ll schedule a 2‑hour maintenance window to provision the warm replicas and validate the autoscale policies.

Attachments: edgeapps_proposal_20270403.pdf (contract), proposed-autoscale-config.yml (autoscale snippet).

Happy to jump on a call if there are any questions.
